1: // Simple Space Junk Defender game
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.offsetWidth || 800;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.offsetHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   const ship = { w: 40, h: 20, x: width / 2, y: height - 30, speed: 0 };
11:   let shield = false;
12:   let health = 3;
13:   let score = 0;
14:   const meteors = [];
15:   let lastSpawn = 0;
16: 
17:   // Input handling – click/drag moves ship, mouse down activates shield
18:   canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
19:     const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
20:     ship.x = e.clientX - rect.left;
21:   });
22:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', () => { shield = true; });
23:   canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => { shield = false; });
24: 
25:   function spawnMeteor() {
26:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 15;
27:     meteors.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - size), y: -size, r: size / 2, vy: 2 + Math.random() * 2 });
28:   }
29: 
30:   function update(dt) {
31:     // spawn every 800ms
32:     if (Date.now() - lastSpawn > 800) { spawnMeteor(); lastSpawn = Date.now(); }
33:     // move meteors
34:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
35:       const m = meteors[i];
36:       m.y += m.vy;
37:       // collision with ship
38:       const dx = Math.abs(m.x + m.r - ship.x);
39:       const dy = Math.abs(m.y + m.r - ship.y);
40:       const coll = dx < ship.w / 2 && dy < ship.h / 2;
41:       if (coll) {
42:         if (shield) { score++; meteors.splice(i, 1); continue; }
43:         health--; meteors.splice(i, 1); if (health <= 0) { gameOver(); return; }
44:       } else if (m.y - m.r > height) {
45:         meteors.splice(i, 1); // missed
46:       }
47:     }
48:   }
49: 
50:   function draw() {
51:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
52:     // ship
53:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0af';
54:     ctx.fillRect(ship.x - ship.w / 2, ship.y, ship.w, ship.h);
55:     // shield
56:     if (shield) {
57:       ctx.beginPath();
58:       ctx.arc(ship.x, ship.y, ship.w, 0, Math.PI * 2);
59:       ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,255,255,0.5)';
60:       ctx.lineWidth = 4;
61:       ctx.stroke();
62:     }
63:     // meteors
64:     ctx.fillStyle = '#aaa';
65:     meteors.forEach(m => {
66:       ctx.beginPath();
67:       ctx.arc(m.x + m.r, m.y + m.r, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
68:       ctx.fill();
69:     });
70:     // UI
71:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
72:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
73:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
74:     ctx.fillText(`Health: ${health}`, 10, 40);
75:   }
76: 
77:   let lastTime = 0;
78:   function loop(timestamp) {
79:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
80:     lastTime = timestamp;
81:     update(dt);
82:     draw();
83:     if (running) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
84:   }
85:   let running = true;
86:   function gameOver() {
87:     running = false;
88:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
89:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
90:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f33';
91:     ctx.textAlign = 'center';
92:     ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
93:     ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
94:   }
95: 
96:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
97: })();

(End of file - total 97 lines)
</content>
